data.name: Startup_Error_Message
data.value: Something went wrong while starting Lumen. Details were written to the log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lumen\logs.

data.name: Library_Empty
data.value: No games yet. Lumen finds the games installed with your stores (Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Battle.net, Xbox) by itself; you can also add any game or app with Add, or by dragging an .exe, a shortcut or a link here.

data.name: Library_ScanProblems
data.value: Some items from {0} could not be read. Details are in the log.

data.name: Library_ScanFailed
data.value: The library could not be scanned. Details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Description
data.value: Add your Steam Web API key and SteamID64 to also see the games you own but haven't installed. The key is encrypted on this PC and is only sent to Steam.

data.name: Settings_Steam_SteamIdHint
data.value: The 17-digit number in steamcommunity.com/profiles/…. If your profile has a custom URL, you can find the number in Steam → Account details.

data.name: Settings_Steam_KeySavedHint
data.value: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Private
data.value: Connected, but your game details are private, so Steam lists no games. In Steam, open your profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings and set Game details to Public.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKey
data.value: Steam rejected this key. Check it on the Steam API key page.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach Steam. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidSteamId
data.value: Enter a SteamID64 (17 digits starting with 7656119) or a steamcommunity.com/profiles/… URL.

data.name: Settings_Steam_MissingKey
data.value: Enter your Steam Web API key.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKeyFormat
data.value: That doesn't look like a Steam Web API key (32 letters and numbers).

data.name: Settings_Steam_Removed
data.value: Steam account details removed from this PC.

data.name: Settings_Steam_KeyHint
data.value: When Steam asks for a domain name, any name works (for example localhost): Lumen doesn't use it.

data.name: Manual_RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove "{0}" from Lumen? The file itself is not touched.

data.name: Manual_SaveFailed
data.value: The item could not be saved. Details are in the log.

data.name: Manual_Error_TitleTooLong
data.value: The name can have up to 120 characters.

data.name: Manual_Error_TargetMissing
data.value: Choose a file or enter a web address.

data.name: Manual_Error_UnsupportedFileType
data.value: Only .exe, .lnk and .url files can be added.

data.name: Manual_Error_RelativePath
data.value: Use the full path, for example C:\Games\game.exe.

data.name: Manual_Error_UnsupportedUrl
data.value: This kind of address isn't allowed, for your safety.

data.name: Manual_Error_ArgumentsTooLong
data.value: Launch arguments can have up to 2000 characters.

data.name: Manual_Error_ArgumentsNotAllowed
data.value: Launch arguments only work with .exe files.

data.name: Settings_Library_MergeDescription
data.value: A game you own on several stores shows up once, and Play uses the store where it's installed. If you showed stores separately or picked a store for a game, you can go back to automatic grouping here.

data.name: Settings_Library_ResetDone
data.value: Grouping was reset: games are grouped automatically again.

data.name: Artwork_InvalidImage
data.value: That file isn't a JPG, PNG or WebP image (or it's larger than 10 MB).

data.name: Settings_Artwork_Description
data.value: Steam games get their covers from Steam automatically. Add a free SteamGridDB API key to also get covers for games from other stores and manual items. The key is encrypted on this PC and only sent to SteamGridDB.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_KeySaved
data.value: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Connected
data.value: Connected. Covers for your other games will load as you browse the library.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_InvalidKey
data.value: SteamGridDB rejected this key. Check it on your SteamGridDB profile.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_InvalidKeyFormat
data.value: Paste the key from your SteamGridDB profile (letters and numbers only).

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach SteamGridDB. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Removed
data.value: SteamGridDB key removed from this PC. Covers already downloaded stay.

data.name: Settings_Artwork_CacheCleared
data.value: Artwork cache cleared. Covers will download again as you browse; custom covers were kept.

data.name: Library_NoMatches
data.value: Nothing matches your search and filters.
